Racing Country on the City’s Edge Keeneland is less a conventional urban neighbourhood than a distinctive rural-urban landscape on Lexington’s south-western edge, organised around Keeneland Race Course and the broad approaches to Blue Grass Airport. The area sits along Versailles Road amid paddocks, limestone fences, horse farms, mature trees and low-density development, offering a markedly different experience from central Lexington’s streets and commercial districts. Its identity is inseparable from the Thoroughbred industry that shapes the wider Bluegrass region, but Keeneland preserves that connection in a particularly visible form.
